what: A curtain in the opposite color (black) to the covering background opens with a logo and notice that turn on over 1s, .05s after opening, and the cursor is the word enter instead of an arrow. Pressing anywhere on the curtain or pressing Esc makes the text sink into the curtain color in 1s and disappear, and 1s after the press the curtain lifts in 1.5s (all ease). fx:enter fires on press and fx:open when lifting begins, and these are used to turn on the header menus in order. On touch screens and narrow screens there is a one-line enter below the text instead of the cursor.

options.wait: Time until text turns on after opening (sec), default .05
options.ink: Time for the text to settle into its color after pressing (sec), default 1
options.hold: Time from press until the curtain starts to open (sec), default 1 — fx:open fires then
options.label: Cursor text, default enter — if empty, the normal cursor
options.lock: 1 locks page scroll until it lifts (default is unlocked — in the original it rolls behind the curtain)
options.[data-fx-part=ink]: Group of text that settles down (logo, notice) — if absent, it turns on right away and only the curtain lifts
options.[data-fx-part=enter]: (if present) one enter line shown only on touch and narrow screens
options.fx:enter · fx:open: On press · from element to bubble when the curtain starts to lift

use:
Your usage guide sentence here

enter
